rows.title: Without expected $10M boost, CT internships forced to cut back
rows.standfirst: The final budget deal included $5 million for youth internships — the same as last year, but half the amount many programs expected.

rows.title: CT finances projected to stay flush — even after COVID aid expires
rows.standfirst: CT finances are projected to stay at the $1B mark through mid-2027. Preparations for the next recession far exceed those for 2007-09 downturn.

rows.title: Diesel tax freeze renews push for long-term fuel tax relief
rows.standfirst: Advocates for CT trucking companies, gas stations and others are calling for permanent relief from fuel taxes.

rows.title: Is CT an ‘emerging bright spot’? This national group thinks so
rows.standfirst: While CT limited tax relief to the poor and middle class, most states did not, according to a report from a Washington, D.C. policy group.

rows.title: CT to take a deeper look at whether state taxes are fair
rows.standfirst: CT’s first tax analysis in 2014 found the poorest households paid three times the share of their incomes in taxes than the wealthiest did.

rows.title: My Connecticut employer didn’t pay me. What should I do?
rows.standfirst: If you worked for a Connecticut employer and weren’t paid for your time, you may be able to file a wage complaint. Here’s what to know.
